featured.name: Official ETS2 Convoy - September 2026
featured.description:
### Our Official September Convoy of 2026 has been scheduled and you're **all invited**! 👀  

> This month, we are heading to Edirne, traveling through Turkey, Bulgaria & Romania to Iași.

The event takes place on the **19th September 2026** at **17:00 UTC!**  


---


### :book: | **Information**  

The convoy duration is estimated to be around **90 minutes**, possibly a bit more if you're near the rear!    

No breaks are scheduled, but you are welcome to pull over in a safe place if you require to do so!    

You can find the departure in your time by zone following **[this](https://notime.zone/OyTN4LveUbiJ1)** link.    

![Route Image](https://static.truckersmp.com/images/event/map/36983.1785068670.png)

---


### :parking: | **Parking**  

> You may park at any company available in **Edirne** with a **no collision zone**.   

Depending on the capacity required we may block some companies off with signs and barriers, so ensure you head to a company that is open.    

There is plenty of space, please **do not park on pavements**.  

As for the destination, the Event Team will direct you to what company to park in.  


---


> Please feel free to comment or ask questions in our Discord channel **[#official-convoy](https://discord.com/channels/307433337126125568/720400776366653490)** or on the forum post **[here](https://forum.truckersmp.com/index.php?/topic/120939-official-ets2-convoy-september-2026/)**!

today.name: WITTENBERG LOGISTICS | 1. TRUCKTREFF
today.description:
![](https://i.postimg.cc/MTyYVDBw/TMP-EI-Banner.png)

Die **Wittenberg Logistics** lädt euch herzlich zu unserem **1. Truckingtreff** ein!

Bevor unser Truckingtreff beginnt, starten wir gemeinsam mit einem **Convoy**. Wir treffen uns um **18:30 Uhr in Hannover – FCP (Slots)** und fahren um **19:00 Uhr** gemeinsam zum **Hamburger Parkplatz**, wo anschließend unser **Truckingtreff** stattfindet.

📍 **Start:** Hannover | FCP (Slots)

🕡 **Treffpunkt:** 18:30 Uhr

🚛 **Abfahrt:** 19:00 Uhr

🏁 **Ziel:** Hamburger Parkplatz

🤝 **Truckingtreff:** anschließend in Hamburg (Parkplatz)

🖥️ **Server:** Simulation 2

Ihr habt die Möglichkeit, **am gemeinsamen Convoy teilzunehmen und anschließend beim Truckingtreff in Hamburg dabei zu sein** oder **direkt zum Hamburger Parkplatz zu kommen**, falls ihr nur am Truckingtreff teilnehmen möchtet.

🚛 **Hinweis für Einzelspieler:** Solltet ihr **keiner VTC angehören**, bitten wir euch, euch **am Ende von Slot 4** einzuordnen, damit der Convoy geordnet und reibungslos starten kann. Vielen Dank für eure Unterstützung!

Wir freuen uns auf zahlreiche Teilnehmer, interessante Gespräche und viele beeindruckende Fahrzeuge.

![](https://i.postimg.cc/gkfyzNf6/TMP-ORGA.png)

today.name: 3 Lata Wladcy Szos
today.description:
Przed rozpoczęciem konwoju, możesz bezpośrednio zapytać organizatora o zasady obowiązujące podczas danego przejazdu.****
Konwoje polegają na wzajemnym wsparciu i ochronie. Uczestnicy powinni stosować się do poleceń organizatora i utrzymywać spójność grupy, często korzystając z komunikacji głosowej w programach takich jak Discord.
Chociaż maksymalna prędkość w grze wynosi 110 km/h, podczas konwoju często ustala się niższe, bezpieczne tempo, aby zachować spójność grupy i zapewnić płynność ruchu
Należy przestrzegać wszystkich ogólnych zasad TruckersMP, w tym zakazu używania niektórych modów, które mogą zakłócać rozgrywkę
Ważne jest, aby stosować się do instrukcji organizatora konwoju, ponieważ to on odpowiada za bezpieczeństwo i przebieg przejazdu.
Większość organizatorów publikuje szczegółowe zasady konwoju w swoich grupach na platformach takich jak Discord, Reddit czy fora TruckersMP.
Przed rozpoczęciem konwoju, możesz bezpośrednio zapytać organizatora o zasady obowiązujące podczas danego przejazdu.
podczas konwoju mozna wyprzedzac celem dolaczenia do swojej grupy

today.name: Eröffnungskonvoi Eifel Express
today.description:
Wenn ihr diesen Konvoi seht, dann seid ihr herzlichst eingeladen zu dem Eröffnungskonvoi des Eifel Express. Wir sind neue neue VTC, gegründet am 31.07.2026 und freuen uns nun auf unseren ersten Konvoi. 


》Treffpunkt: Sim2, 19:30 Uhr in Amsterdam auf Parkplatz (NL)

》Abfahrt: 20 Uhr

》Streckenlänge: 2.000km

》Ziel: Koper (SLO) großer Parkplatz

Wir haben für zwischendurch in der Schweiz zwischen Bern & Zürich eine Pause auf der Raststätte geplant, für 15 Minuten. 

![](https://i.imgur.com/tqF7X0e.jpeg[img]https://i.imgur.com/tqF7X0e.jpeg[/img])

Dieser Konvoi wird nebenbei auf TikTok live übertragen, also schaut gerne vorbei. Jeder darf gerne Fotos machen und diese mir zukommen lassen, wir wünschen allen einen schönen Konvoi.
Wir bitte an die VTCs, dass jeder, der mitfährt sich zusätzlich auch nochmal selber anmeldet, in der Hoffnung ab 50 Teilnehmern einen Extra Konvoi Server zu beantragen.

![](https://i.imgur.com/SZ11MQa.jpeg)
today.rule:
》Auf die Konvoiführung hören!
》Mit vollem Tank erscheinen!
》Mit reparierten Truck erscheinen!
》Keine Double- oder HCT Trailers oder Tiefbett etc.
》Pünktlich sein, auch nach Pause!
》Bei Unfall bitte möglichst schnell F7 - Back to Road klicken um weitere Unfälle zu vermeiden!
》Bei Positionsverlust erst bei Möglichkeit und Zusage der Führung wieder zur eigenen 0Firma überholen und aufschließen!
》Wer einen Auftrag fahren möchte, schreibt sich einen Auftrag zu Koper - Euro Goodies, lädt dort ab und kommt danach auf den Parkplatz!

now.rule:
## Event Rules for Participants:
* The Event Staff are recognized as; "**Brave | CC, Media, Supervisor, GM Support**" or *similar*.
* Impersonating Event Staff using the aforementioned tags is forbidden.
* Participants must follow Event Staff instructions.
* Participants should park at their designated slots. If you do not have a designated slot you are required to park in the 'Public Parking' area.
* Participants must only leave the starting location when instructed to do so in an orderly (one by one) manner.
* Participants with consistent lag must remain at the back of the convoy.
* Cars are prohibited except for Event Staff showing a clear tag.
* Buses are prohibited.
* Overtaking is prohibited. (Except Event Staff)
* Advertising is prohibited. (Except Event Staff)
* Participants must haul a trailer. (Except Event Staff)
* Triple trailers, HCT trailers and Heavy Haul configurations are prohibited. (Except Event Staff)
* Free roaming on the server is prohibited.
* As long as it is safe, participants must catch up to the convoy if a gap is present.
* Participants must ignore traffic lights unless it is unsafe to do so.
* All other [TruckersMP Rules](https://truckersmp.com/rules) apply.

## Event Rules for Event Staff:
* Event Staff can block junctions and roads approaching junctions in order to direct the convoy.
* Event Staff overtaking the convoy cannot be performed by more than 2 members at a time.
* Event Staff can drive the incorrect way where roads have a central reservation barrier ONLY. In accordance with the rule above.
* Event Staff can park out of bounds. Providing this is on the ground and not on top of buildings or other inappropriate places deemed unsuitable by TruckersMP Staff.
* All other [TruckersMP Rules](https://truckersmp.com/rules) apply.

1. 🚛 **Follow Convoy Control** — All participants must follow instructions given by Convoy Control and event staff at all times.

3. 🚦 **Follow Traffic Rules** — Respect traffic lights, road signs, speed limits, and right-of-way rules wherever applicable.

5. 📻 **Follow Convoy Formation** — Stay in your assigned position and maintain the convoy order throughout the route.

6. 🔄 **No Unnecessary Overtaking** — Overtaking is only permitted when instructed by Convoy Control or when absolutely necessary.

7. 🎙️ **Keep Communications Clear** — Keep voice communications clear during the convoy and avoid unnecessary radio spam.

8. 🅿️ **Follow Parking Instructions** — Park only in designated areas and follow staff instructions during stops and at the destination.

9. 🤝 **Respect Everyone** — Treat all participants, staff, and other road users with respect and professionalism.

10. ⚠️ **Staff Decisions Are Final** — Event staff and Convoy Control have the final authority during the event. Please cooperate with their instructions.

upcoming.rule:
**GPE | Event Rules for Participants:**

* Only approved Event Staff are able to use the following words or phrases in their player tag; "GPE | Convoy Lead", "GPE | Convoy Co-Lead", "GPE | Convoy Tail", "GPE | Convoy Co-Tail", "GPE | Event Staff", "GPE | Media Staff", "GPE | Supervisor", "GPE | Event Organiser", “GPE | Event Manager” or "GPE | Founder".
* Participants must follow Event Staff instructions.
* Participants must haul a trailer. | Except for Event Staff.
* Advertising is prohibited. | Except for Event Staff.
* Cars and buses are prohibited except for event staff showing a clear tag.
* Triple trailers, HCT trailers and Heavy Haul configurations are prohibited. | Except for Event Staff.
* Participants should park at their designated slots. If you don't have a designated slot you are required to park at the 'Public Parking'.
* Convoy participants must only leave the starting location when instructed to do so in an orderly (one by one) manner.
* Free-roaming on the server is strictly prohibited.
* Overtaking is prohibited.
* All other [TruckersMP](https://truckersmp.com/rules) rules apply.

**GPE | Event Staff Rules:**

* Media & Event Staff can park out of bounds. Providing this is on the ground and not on top of buildings or other inappropriate places deemed unsuitable by TruckersMP Staff.
* Event Staff can block junctions and roads approaching junctions in order to direct the convoy.
* Event Staff overtaking the convoy cannot be performed by more than 2 members at a time.
* Event Staff can drive the incorrect way where roads have a central reservation barrier ONLY. In accordance with the rule above.
* All other [TruckersMP](https://truckersmp.com/rules) rules apply.

upcoming.name: DEAF DAY´S CONVOY WITHOUT VOICE!
upcoming.description:
## DEAF DAY´S CONVOY WITHOUT VOICE!
- Konvoj k mezinárodnímu dni neslyšících bez voice chatu.
## 

-----

![](https://i.imgur.com/HBWLxSd.png)

-----

![](https://i.ibb.co/jD3mPFj/CONVOY-RULES.png)


1. Respect the instructions on our Discord server - **Luky Transport Discord Server.**
2. Drive according to the rules and avoid accidents.
3. Follow company rules, they are of great importance.
4. Stick to the prescribed schedule and convoy plan.
5. Have your job and truck ready at the start of the convoy. (FULL FUEL)
6. Cargo is not limited for this convoy.
7. No voice calls are allowed during this convoy.
8. Confirm your participation.
9. If your company has more than 5 members and you want to participate, you must reserve a slot on our Discord server - [link here.](https://discord.gg/lukytransport)


-----

![](https://i.ibb.co/PCv3Xb9/schedule.png)

*  **18:30**  - Meetup at Lyon at parking slots in Stein Bruch.
*  **19:00** -  Departure from the Lyon towards La Manche.
*  **19:50** -  Arrival to the EuroTunnel and train boarding.
*  **20:00** -  Departure from Dover - EuroTunnel.
*  **20:25**  - Passage around the cities Cardiff and Swansea.
*  **20:50**  - Arrival to the City of Manchester.
*  **21:00**  - Final group photo and end of the convoy!

![](https://i.imgur.com/qPEhXyX.png)

![](https://i.imgur.com/SB22BpV.png)

-----

![](https://i.ibb.co/CKRRfZ8/CJ.png)

**1. Lyon, Stein Bruch - Manchester, LKW.**


-----

![](https://i.ibb.co/Kctz2JT/SLOT-RESERVATION.png)


To ride on this convoy for companies with more than 5 MEMBERS, slot registration is required.

For this, simply use the new slot feature on our [Discord server](https://discord.gg/lukytransport).

**Correct Registration Procedure:**

1. [Select your slot](https://discord.com/channels/1071510975196438528/1225995618955300874) with the code number in the room or on the convoy page.
2. Create a new ticket for booking a slot in the [#ticket room on our Discord.](https://discord.com/channels/1071510975196438528/1225533050616676544)
3. Fill out the registration form, indicating the slot you are interested in.
4. Our management will confirm your registration through the ticket.

*Remember to monitor slot occupancy on the server and communicate with us.*


-----

## PUBLIC + RESERVATION SLOTS

![](https://i.imgur.com/dCkra7t.jpeg)

## PRIVATE LTR SLOTS

![](https://i.imgur.com/DvKOXtp.jpeg)


*If your company has less than 5 members or you are a member of our company, you do not need to reserve a slot.*


## [FOR RESERVATION OF SLOT VISIT OUR DISCORD!](https://discord.gg/gHnKQqYpHu)
